references.title: K-pop sensation BTS is set to make a full-group comeback in March 2026, as confirmed by their agency BigHit Entertainment (@bighit_ent) on Friday (6/20). The announcement comes as anticipation builds among fans following a two-year hiatus during which members pursued individual activities and completed their mandatory military service. The final member, SUGA, officially completed his military duty on Saturday (6/21), marking the end of the group’s enlistment period and clearing the path for their long-awaited reunion. Although BigHit Music has yet to release a detailed statement regarding the comeback, HYBE CEO Lee Jae Sang emphasized that BTS will take time to focus on creative development and preparations before returning to the stage. In the meantime, Jin is set to lead the group’s post-military era with his solo concert tour Runseokjin_EP.Tour, kicking off June 28–29 in Goyang, South Korea. #SEAToday #SEATodayNews #SEATodaydotcom #Jakarta #Indonesia #BTS #Comeback
